opus.proposed_fix: 1. On the server, run `systemctl status copycat` and `journalctl -u copycat --since '04:00' -n 200`. That shows whether it is hung or restart-looping. Look for a traceback or the last log line before the silence. 2. Restart with `systemctl restart copycat` and confirm the status file updates within 5 minutes. 3. If it hung on a network call, add request timeouts to the copycat fetch/poll loop. Also add a watchdog, either systemd WatchdogSec with sd_notify or a self-check that exits if no status write happens for 15 minutes, so systemd restarts it. 4. If it is restart-looping, fix the startup exception shown in the journal.
